questions.question: You can pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the lane you want to enter is a ____ line.
questions.correctAnswerText: Broken white
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going in the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass if the passing lane is clear.

questions.question: Your blind spot is the area you:

options.text: Cannot see without turning your head.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cannot see without turning your head.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see without turning your head. They are found to the sides and behind your vehicle.

questions.question: Most warning signs are:
questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow.
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black text. They warn drivers about unexpected conditions ahead.

questions.question: What should you do if your accelerator gets stuck while driving?

options.text: Reach down and try to pull it up.
Shift to neutral and press the brake steadily.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to neutral and press the brake steadily.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks, keep your eyes on the road. Shift into neutral and press the brake steadily. When safe, pull off the road and turn off the engine.

questions.question: On a long trip, you should:

options.text: Stop and rest every two hours.
Drive with one eye open at a time.
Switch feet on the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest every two hours.
questions.explanation: To prevent fatigue on a long trip, take a break every two hours. If you become drowsy, pull over safely and nap or stay at a hotel overnight.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, you should:

options.text: Stay calm and move out of their way.
Flash your lights to show they are wrong.
Do something to get back at them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay calm and move out of their way.
questions.explanation: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, stay calm and get out of their way. Trying to get even makes the situation more dangerous.

questions.question: After a school bus stops to let children off, you should:

options.text: Not move until the children wave at you.
Watch for children walking on the side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children walking on the side of the road.
questions.explanation: After a school bus with a stop arm and flashing lights lets children off, watch for children walking along the road. Always drive carefully around children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Red, yellow, green.
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is on top and green is on bottom. On a horizontal light, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: You have a green light at an intersection, but pedestrians are crossing against the red light. You should:

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of them.
Stop to let them cross safely.
Drive close to frighten them so they don't cross against the light again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to let them cross safely.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross safely, even if you have a green light and they don't. Be careful around pedestrians at all times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where the sign is posted.

questions.question: When can you go through an intersection with a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to check for cross traffic
After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe
questions.explanation: Stop before the stop line or crosswalk at any stop sign. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before entering the intersection. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: A driver entering public traffic from a driveway or private road:

options.text: Should let drivers on the public road go first.
Can force their way into traffic.
Can assume other drivers will change lanes for them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should let drivers on the public road go first.
questions.explanation: If you are entering traffic from a driveway or private road, let drivers already on the public road go first. Merge safely when you can.

questions.question: When backing up, you should:

options.text: Open your door to see if it is safe.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: Always check behind your vehicle before backing up. Children and small objects are hard to see from your seat. Turn your head to look through the rear window. Do not rely only on mirrors or sensors.

questions.question: Stop lines are solid white lines painted across traffic lanes:
questions.correctAnswerText: At intersections and pedestrian crosswalks.
questions.explanation: Stop lines are solid white lines at intersections and pedestrian crosswalks. They show where drivers must stop.

questions.question: You must use extra caution near a pedestrian with a white cane because:
questions.correctAnswerText: They are blind.
questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog means the person is blind. Slow down, yield the right-of-way, and be ready to stop to keep them safe.

questions.question: You can legally pass on the right side of another vehicle:

options.text: If the vehicle is turning left and there is an available passing lane.
Even if you have to drive off the pavement.

questions.correctAnswerText: If the vehicle is turning left and there is an available passing lane.
questions.explanation: You can pass on the right if there is an available passing lane and the vehicle is turning left or waiting to turn left. You can also pass on the right on multilane roads with two or more lanes in the same direction. Never drive off the pavement to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle unattended, you must:

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do all of the above.
questions.explanation: When you leave your vehicle, stop the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are about to become one lane.

questions.question: You have the right-of-way when turning left on which traffic signal?
questions.correctAnswerText: A green arrow pointing left
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go in the direction the arrow points. Oncoming traffic must stop.

questions.question: When there is an oncoming car to your left and a cyclist to your right, you should:

options.text: Let the car pass, then pass the cyclist.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car pass, then pass the cyclist.
questions.explanation: Handle one hazard at a time. Let the oncoming car pass first, then pass the cyclist. Do not try to squeeze between both at the same time.

questions.question: What driving technique helps drivers avoid crashes on icy or snowy roads?

options.text: Add extra weight to the vehicle to improve traction.
Get off the highways as quickly as possible.
Slow down and stay farther behind other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stay farther behind other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Slow down on snow or ice. Slowing down and keeping a larger distance between your vehicle and others are the most important ways to avoid crashes in snow or ice.

questions.question: A driver entering a highway from an entrance or acceleration ramp should:

options.text: Let drivers already on the highway go first.
Assume other drivers will change lanes for them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let drivers already on the highway go first.
questions.explanation: If you are entering a highway from an entrance or acceleration ramp, you must let drivers already on the highway go first. Merge into traffic safely when you have space.

questions.question: To enter a freeway correctly, you should:

options.text: Signal, let traffic go first, and enter at the same speed as other traffic.
Signal and enter. Freeway traffic must let you in.
Drive slowly so you can watch traffic.
Always come to a complete stop first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, let traffic go first, and enter at the same speed as other traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging onto a freeway, signal and enter at the same speed as the traffic. Always let other traffic go first.

questions.question: What is true about drowsy drivers?

options.text: Strong black coffee will keep them awake.
They may drive as poorly as someone who is drunk.
Opening a window or turning up the radio will keep them alert.

questions.correctAnswerText: They may drive as poorly as someone who is drunk.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers may drive as poorly as someone who is drunk. Opening a window, turning on the radio, or drinking coffee are not enough to keep a drowsy driver alert.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spots?

options.text: Turn your head and look over your shoulders.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulders.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see in your mirrors. To check them, turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.question: The best way to handle a tailgater is to:

options.text: Speed up to create more distance.
Brake suddenly to make them back off.
Change lanes or slow down gradually to let them pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes or slow down gradually to let them pass.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often to see if a car is following too closely. If it is, slow down gradually and let them pass. Most rear-end crashes happen because cars follow too closely.

questions.question: When stopped by police or at a vehicle check, you must show:
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: You must have your license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance with you when driving. All three documents are required.

questions.question: You see a driver ahead using one hand and talking to a passenger. You should:

options.text: Keep extra distance from that vehicle.
Know they are not paying full attention and are less safe.
Not drive the same way they are driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Do not get distracted while driving by passengers, looking for things, reading, or daydreaming. If another driver seems distracted, stay far away from them because the risk of a crash is higher.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in condominium complexes if no sign is posted?
questions.correctAnswerText: 25 mph.
questions.explanation: The speed limit in condominium complexes is 25 mph unless a different speed is posted. Follow any posted speed limit.

questions.question: When turning left, you must let the right-of-way go to:

options.text: Other vehicles already in the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: When turning left, let oncoming traffic go first. Always let pedestrians, bicyclists, and other vehicles in the intersection go first.
